subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The GM EV1 Experiment
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The GM EV1 Experiment.

hook.text: In 1996, General Motors released the EV1—the first modern electric car from a major automaker.

buildup.text: It was sleek, fast, and fully electric. Drivers loved it. Celebrities leased them in California.

discovery.text: GM only offered leases, never sales. About 1,100 were produced over three years.

twist.text: In 2003, GM canceled the program and crushed nearly every EV1. Owners begged to buy them.

climax.text: The documentary 'Who Killed the Electric Car?' blamed oil companies, dealers, and GM itself.

punchline.text: GM built the future—then destroyed it.

quiz.question: What happened to most GM EV1 cars?
